rationale:
The requirement fixes one structural item: the description text of the submission tool. `Finish by submitting your structured result in result. Exactly one accepted submission ends this call.`

In `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tools.rs#impl[GraphSession<'_, '_, D>/Conversation]/fn[tools]`, the `submit_result` tool definition carries a `description` string that matches this text character for character. The definition is built in `tools` and deserialized into a `ToolDefinition`. The returned tool list includes it. The function is marked `{impl}` for this requirement, and it is the only impl site.

The parent `submission.mcp` requirement covers the tool's name and argument schema. That is a separate declaration. The same function builds the `parameters` from `self.parameters`, so the description does not conflict with it.

The text is a fixed string. I found no separate runtime behavior to check. I found no gaps and no ambiguities, and there are no acknowledgments.
